messages.author: 210b6b0b19de9aec
messages.subject: Error in cameraOptions
parts:
Hi,

I am having issues using the camOp code listed as follows:

camOp <- cameraOperation(CTtable = actividad_cam, 
                   stationCol = "Station", 
                   cameraCol, 
                    setupCol = 'Fecha_colocacion', 
                    retrievalCol = 'Fecha_retiro', 
                    hasProblems = 'TRUE',
                   byCamera, 
                   allCamsOn, 
                   camerasIndependent,
                   dateFormat = '%Y/%m/%d', 
                    writecsv = FALSE, 
                    outDir
)
The error that I am getting is:

Error in cameraOperation(CTtable = actividad_cam, stationCol = "Station", : is.logical(hasProblems) is not TRUE

I want to create a camOp matrix in order to determinate the IAR ant I think is one of the first steps.

Using the traceback function this is what i get:

3: stop(simpleError(msg, call = if (p <- sys.parent(1L)) sys.call(p))) 
2: stopifnot(is.logical(hasProblems)) 
1: cameraOperation(CTtable = actividad_cam, stationCol = "Station", cameraCol, setupCol = "Fecha_colocacion", retrievalCol = "Fecha_retiro", hasProblems = "TRUE", byCamera, allCamsOn, camerasIndependent, dateFormat = "%Y/%m/%d", writecsv = FALSE, outDir

I am new using the package and my guide (Fototrampeo en R) uses an outdated version of the package. Thank you so much for your assistance and for creating this useful tool.

Regards

Carlos Camacho.

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error in cameraOptions
parts:
Hi Carlos,
you accidentally quoted 'TRUE' in:
hasProblems = 'TRUE'

It should be:
hasProblems = TRUE

Best regards,
Jürgen
